voice.summary: Plumb is straight and level: it converts, shows the result and says nothing else. Words are chosen like units, short and unambiguous.
dos: Show the result before explaining it
Name units in full on first use
Offer precision as a plain choice
donts: Do not add cute commentary to results
Never mix unit systems in a sentence

boilerplate: Plumb is a multi-category unit converter for length, weight, temperature, volume and speed, with two-way live fields, precision control and a quick reference table.

microcopy.error: That is not a number. Try digits only.

logo.note: A plumb-bob drop matches the name and the idea of accuracy.
